content.name: Pact of the Chain
entries: You learn the {@spell find familiar} spell and can cast it as a ritual. The spell doesn't count against your number of spells known.

When you cast the spell, you can choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: {@creature imp}, {@creature pseudodragon}, {@creature quasit}, or {@creature sprite}.
Additionally, when you take the {@action Attack} action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to use its reaction to make one attack of its own.

content.name: Pact of the Chain
entries: You learn the {@spell Find Familiar|SRD52} spell and can cast it as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: {@creature Imp|SRD52}, {@creature Pseudodragon|SRD52}, {@creature Quasit|SRD52}, {@creature Skeleton|SRD52}, {@creature Sphinx of Wonder|SRD52}, {@creature Sprite|SRD52}, or {@creature Venomous Snake|SRD52} (see "Monsters" for the familiar's stat block).
Additionally, when you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52}.
